Click actual Close map, then S 4.5 s and W 0.45 s. The car is near a facade with Stuck? Get back on the road, 1,954 m, 5 km/h and 10.0 s boost.

Press R a third time. With no driving input during the glide, wait for a settled clear street at 1,948 m, 0 km/h and 10.0 s boost. Save the original endpoint screenshot, then P opens Paused. Inspect warning/error logs (empty) and mark this unfinished order as handoff.
